instruction: Candid medium shot in a bright indoor room. On the left, the woman in the white sleeveless top (R3) leans forward with open arms. In the center, the man in the yellow t-shirt (R2) holds the little girl in the light long-sleeve shirt (R1) as she reaches toward the woman. Soft natural light fills the space, creating a warm, joyful atmosphere.
elements: R2 holds/supports R1 as R1 reaches toward R3
R1 is the little girl being held by R2, not the holder
R3 leans forward with open arms toward the approaching R1
R2 serves as the carrier/supporter while R3 is the open-armed greeter

questions.q: Is R2 holding and supporting R1 as she reaches outward, rather than R1 holding and supporting R2?
